input.summary: Ported scan.cu to idiomatic SYCL 2020 in migrated/scan.dp.cpp. No dpct headers, dpct:: helpers or DPCT_* macros remain. The port uses sycl::queue (in-order), sycl::malloc_device/sycl::free, a 1-D sycl::nd_range<1>, sycl::local_accessor for the shared-memory temp arrays, and sycl::group_barrier(item.get_group()) in place of __syncthreads. The kernels are plain functions taking nd_item<1> and a local pointer. Compile with icpx -fsycl is clean (0 warnings) with add_dpct_include=false. Correctness: a host reference (per-block exclusive scan of the same LCG input, both plain and bank-conflict-avoiding outputs written as float64) matched exactly, 0 mismatches, for n=1048576 (2097152 values), n=1000 with 3 repeats, and n=77. The exact-match bar (atol=rtol=0) is met.
